arabic text: ZAINAB KE SIWA KAARE KHUDA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: WHO WILL CARRY OUT THIS SERVICE TO ALLAH APART FROM ZAYNAB?

arabic text: SAR TAN SE JUDA HOTE HI ZAINAB YE PUKARI\nQURAN BHALA HAMSE JUDA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: AS SOON AS THE HEAD WAS SEVERED FROM THE BODY, ZAINAB CRIED,\n'WHO CAN SEPARATE THE QUR'AN FROM US?'

arabic text: SADIYON SE ISI SAUCH ME GHAM KARBOBALA THI\nHUN KHAAK MUJHE KHAAKE SHIFAA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: SINCE CENTURIES KARBALA WAS LOST IN THIS THOUGHT,\n'I AM JUST ORDINARY EARTH, WHO WILL CONVERT ME TO KHAK-E-SHIFA?',

arabic text: DARKAAR HAI MAZLOOM ASEERO KO REHAYI\nYEH KAAM SAKINA KE SIWA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: THE OPPRESSED ONE AND THE CAPTIVES NEEDED TO BE SET FREE,\nWHO WILL DO THIS WORK APART FROM SAKINA,

arabic text: HAM JAATE HAIN ZINDAAN SE AY BAALI SAKINA\nROSHAN TERI TURBAT PE DIYA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: WE ARE FINALLY LEAVING THE PRISON, O SAKINA,\nNOW WHO WILL LIGHT A CANDLE AT YOUR GRAVE,

arabic text: BHAIYON KI MAZARAAT PE BIBI NE KAHA THA\nAB HAMSE ULAJNE KI KHATAA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: AT HER BROTHERS' GRAVES THE LADY HAD SAID,\nNOW WHO WILL MAKE THE MISTAKE OF ATTACKING US,

arabic text: YE KHUTBA E ZAINAB KI SADA BOL RAHI HAI\nHAI KAUN SITAMGAAR JAFAA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: THE WORDS FROM THE SERMON OF ZAYNAB ARE ECHOING,\nWHO IS THE OPPRESSOR, AND WHO WILL PERPETRATE INJUSTICE?
